name: Vantge
tagline: Aerial inspection data your engineers can actually trust.
positioning: Vantge turns routine drone flights into structured, defect-tagged inspection records for the teams that maintain critical infrastructure.

hero.h1: Every inspection flight, documented to the millimeter.
hero.sub: Vantge plans the mission, flies the pattern, and returns georeferenced imagery with defects already tagged — so your reliability engineers stop scrubbing raw footage and start making decisions.

features.title: Autonomous flight plans
features.description: Import an asset from your GIS and Vantge generates a repeatable flight path with the overlap and standoff your inspection standard requires — no manual waypointing.

features.title: Defect detection you can audit
features.description: Corrosion, cracking, and thermal anomalies are flagged with confidence scores and pinned to exact coordinates, with the source image one click away for review.

features.title: Inspection records, not folders
features.description: Each flight becomes a versioned record with timestamps, pilot, weather, and sign-off — the audit trail your regulators and insurers ask for.

features.title: Change over time
features.description: Overlay this quarter's scan against last year's to watch a defect propagate, and export the delta straight into your maintenance backlog.

features.title: Fits your stack
features.description: Push findings into SAP, Maximo, or ArcGIS through a documented API so inspection data lands where your planners already work.

features.title: Certified operations
features.description: BVLOS-ready workflows, chain-of-custody logging, and role-based access keep every flight inside your compliance envelope.

testimonials.quote: We used to lose two engineers for a week reviewing tower footage after every campaign. Vantge hands us tagged defects with coordinates the same afternoon the drone lands.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan

testimonials.quote: The versioned records were the deciding factor. When our insurer asked to see the inspection history on a flare stack, we exported it in minutes instead of chasing SD cards.
testimonials.name: Daniel Okafor

testimonials.quote: It reads like it was built by people who've actually stood at the base of a wind turbine in February. The flight plans just match how we inspect.
testimonials.name: Hanne Vestergaard
